strings.cfg_2_progression__skill_loss_on_death_h: Percent of every skill lost on death; the world's death penalty modifier still scales it.
strings.cfg_2_progression__lose_progress_on_deat: Death also clears the progress toward each next level. Off: that progress is kept.
strings.cfg_2_progression__skill_loss_overrides_: Per-skill exceptions to Skill Loss On Death, as Skill=Percent entries separated by commas, for example Swords=0, Run=10. A listed skill loses its own percent (0 to 100) on death; every other skill uses Skill Loss On Death. Empty: every skill uses it. Host or server; applies at the next death.
strings.cfg_2_progression__catch_up_help: Skills below their historical best base level train twice as fast. Character history survives death; explicit skill resets forget it.
strings.cfg_2_progression__weapon_switch_help: Weapon skills below the highest current base weapon level train 50% faster. With Catch Up, only the larger boost applies.
strings.cfg_2_progression__skill_book_help: The Skills window gets an info pane with each skill's page.
strings.cfg_2_progression__skill_gain_notices_he: Show experience gains: Off, SagaSkills (Defense, Sneak, gathering) or All skills.
strings.cfg_2_progression__experience_preset_hel: Host or server. Takes effect immediately. Sets Defense, Woodcutting, Mining and Fishing experience multipliers, Foraging experience per pick, the Woodcutting and Foraging discovery multipliers, and the Mining, Fishing and new-size discovery bonuses. MeadWorksDefault keeps Saga's rates. Vanilla uses multipliers 0.5, 1 experience per pick, discovery multipliers 1 and discovery bonuses 0. Relaxed uses multipliers 2, 6 experience per pick, discovery multipliers 5 and double the discovery bonuses. Custom keeps individual values; editing a member selects Custom. Loading never replaces saved values. Planted Pickable Foraging XP stays as configured.
strings.cfg_2_progression__perk_threshold_preset: Host or server. Takes effect immediately. Sets the 14 perk unlock levels. MeadWorksDefault keeps Saga's levels. Vanilla sets each level to 101, which turns that perk off. Relaxed opens each perk earlier: Defense 10, 25, 50 and 75; Unbroken 75; Read The Rock 10 and Echo 25; Sweep 10; Grace 50; Legendary and Double Bonus 25; Species Sense, Size Sense and Water Sense 10, 25 and 50. Custom keeps individual levels; editing one selects Custom. Loading never replaces saved levels.
strings.cfg_2_progression__perk_strength_preset_: Host or server. Takes effect immediately. Sets the At 100 perk strengths for Defense, Defense Guard, Felling, Chopping, Mining perks, Foraging, Fishing tackle and bite chance. MeadWorksDefault keeps Saga's strengths. Vanilla sets each to 0. Relaxed raises each by half, up to its own maximum. Custom keeps individual values; editing one selects Custom. Loading never replaces saved values.
strings.cfg_2_progression__death_preset_help: Host or server. Takes effect immediately. Sets Skill Loss On Death, Lose Progress On Death and Catch Up. MeadWorksDefault keeps 5 percent loss, lost progress and Catch Up. Vanilla keeps 5 percent loss and lost progress, and turns Catch Up off. Relaxed keeps skills and level progress, with Catch Up on. Custom keeps individual values; editing one selects Custom. Loading never replaces saved values. Skill Loss Overrides stays as configured.
strings.cfg_2_progression__finds_preset_help: Host or server. Takes effect immediately. Sets wood and mine find chances, snag chances, big-fish and legendary chances, and the three vein star shares. MeadWorksDefault keeps Saga's chances. Vanilla sets them to 0. Relaxed raises wood finds to 5 and 30, mine finds to 1 and 3, snags to 5 and 12, big-fish chance to 50, the night bonus to 100, legendary chance to 2, and vein shares to 40, 20 and 10, which total 70. Custom keeps individual values; editing one selects Custom. Loading never replaces saved values.
strings.cfg_3_powers__max_attuned_powers_help: Powers a character can hold at once. Lowering it sets the oldest aside without forgetting them.
strings.cfg_3_powers__kill_credit_range_help: Players within this many meters of a boss when it dies get the kill. 0: unlimited.
strings.cfg_3_powers__block_power_activation_hel: The powers cannot be activated. Off: vanilla activation works on top of the passives.
strings.cfg_3_powers__advanced_power_config_help: Saga.Powers.yml replaces the feature settings for every power it lists.
strings.cfg_3_powers__show_locked_features_help: Hovers and tooltips list locked features, grayed, with the kills still needed.
strings.cfg_3_powers__show_passive_in_status_bar: Each attuned power shows its passive as a status icon.
strings.cfg_3_powers__power_display_mode_help: How several attunements share the power HUD: Stacked, Mixed, Compact, Icons or NewestOnly.
strings.cfg_3_powers__full_power_displays_help: Attunements shown with the full power display.
strings.cfg_3_powers__activate_all_attuned_power: On: one activation runs every attuned power, and the power wheel stays hidden. Off: one activation runs only the power chosen on the wheel. Host or server. Takes effect immediately.
strings.cfg_3_powers__power_wheel_key_help: Key held to show the wheel of your attuned powers. Unbound by default, so it does not take a game key or another MeadWorks key. Bind one the game and your other MeadWorks mods leave free. Almanac warns when that key is already used. Your own control. The wheel stays hidden while Activate All Attuned Powers is on.
strings.cfg_3_powers__power_wheel_gamepad_help: Gamepad button held to show the same wheel. Unbound by default. Aim with the right stick or the D-pad, release the button to choose, or press A. B or Escape cancels. Your own control. The wheel stays hidden while Activate All Attuned Powers is on.
strings.cfg_3_powers__power_strength_preset_help: Host or server. Takes effect immediately. Sets every boss power feature. MeadWorksDefault keeps Saga's feature values. Vanilla sets numbers to 0, switches off and resistances to Normal. Relaxed moves each number 50 percent further from 0, within its range, and raises each resistance one step. Switches stay as they are. Custom keeps individual values; editing one selects Custom. Loading never replaces saved values. While Advanced Power Config is on, Saga.Powers.yml replaces the features it lists.

Sets the line tension bar, tension build and ease, strike windows, the perfect strike, tiring, thrashes, spent reel speed and grace seconds. MeadWorksDefault keeps the bar and Saga's timing. Vanilla turns the bar off and keeps the timing numbers. Relaxed keeps the bar, builds tension at 40 and 20 percent, eases it at 80 percent, opens strike windows to 1 and 1.5 seconds with a 0.35 second perfect strike, tires 25 percent per thrash after 2 thrashes, reels a spent fish 80 percent faster and allows 8 seconds of grace. Custom keeps individual values; editing one selects Custom. Loading never replaces saved values. Grace Level stays on the perk threshold preset.
